propositions: Three committed bridge_state format changes (A2, A3, A4-2) plus one field deletion (A1) require an ADR documenting mixed-version protocol and rollback boundaries.
The mixed-version protocol reads chronological max(new, legacy) and requires direct deployment evidence before stopping legacy writes, not elapsed time.
Bridge state remains committed on the tickets branch to provide durable state for ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners.
A2-2 gate requires A2-1 merged, successful reconcile-bridge.yml run at descendant SHA, explicit host probe refresh with no older process, and old/new-writer self-healing oracle.
Rollback boundaries differ per change: A2-1 and A3 reversible, A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer, A4-2 requires recorded corpus evidence.
Measured outcome: 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1; 218/399 identical prev_snapshot key sets; assignee excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires raw shape.
